title: ReleaseArtifact
description: What was in a release: version, changesets, and breaking changes. Supersedes release-artifact@2 — the changesets array carries changeset@3 summaries, which may be layered Markdown.

changesets.description: changeset@3 entries included in this release. A changeset IS the changelog entry — semver_impact and consumer_impact are set once at authoring time (shared/schemas/changeset@3.json) and consumed here, not re-derived. release-summarizer's version is max(semver_impact) across this array, with consumer_impact: internal-only entries and disposition: none entries filtered out before this array is built.

summary.description: The changeset's summary carried through unedited. Markdown: a lead line, then bullets or audience sections when the author wrote them.

linked_requirement.description: ID of the requirement@1 this changeset addresses

commits.description: Git SHAs included in this changeset

breaking_changes.description: Human-readable descriptions of all breaking changes in this release

migration_guide.description: Optional: instructions for upgrading from the previous version
